title: Dostai of Kfar Yatma
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Mishnah Orlah 2:5, saying, “I heard from Shammai the Elder.” Hyman reports that Kaftor va-Ferach, chapter 11, reads “a man of Kfar Deman Dema,” while Seder HaDorot reads “a man of Kfar Demai.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Kfar Yatma, Kfar Deman Dema and Kfar Demai are kept as distinct reported readings.

The checked whole Mishnah Orlah 2:5 names Dostai of Kfar Yatma and his statement heard from Shammai the Elder. The Kaftor va-Ferach catalogue request returned empty information, which is unavailable rather than proof of absence. Its Deman Dema reading and Seder HaDorot’s Demai reading remain Hyman’s attributed reports, not independently collated apparatus.
